linework.observation: Clean bold contours outline the protagonist, pressure pipes, pump casing and log table; consistent with the canonical interior reference.

colour.observation: Muted steel gray, navy, cream and dusty blue; red valve accents remain limited and scene-appropriate.

shading.observation: Soft cel shading and restrained metal bands model the equipment without photorealistic surfaces.

character_construction.observation: The protagonist is visibly bald with rounded head, nose, ears, eyebrows and mouth; limbs and hands are coherent.

backgrounds.observation: A compact machinery space with pipes, valves, pump and sealed steel hatch reads as an enclosed vessel interior.

finish.observation: Polished illustrated frame with clean edges and legible equipment; no obvious artifacts.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and navy coveralls match the canonical identity and level costume.

content.observation: Sound-powered phone, machinery and log sheet support an equipment-watch scene; no outside view or distracting additions.

composition.observation: Full-body wide view keeps head and boots inside frame; equipment provides depth without covering the focal figure.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist, tired and listening on a handset.
regions.clothing: Navy coveralls and dark boots; appropriate for this level.
regions.foreground_props: Sound-powered handset, log sheet and red pencil reinforce the work scene.
regions.architecture: Bulkhead hatch, pipe runs, gauges and pump create a dense, plausible machinery room.
regions.distance: Pipes and equipment recede behind the character, remaining legible.
regions.lighting: Warm overhead fixtures with subdued blue-gray equipment tones and small red valve accents.
